text: Show phase aims ranked by priority and state
description: Add a phase-header “show priority” control that ranks non-archived aims across the selected phase and all descendant phases by calculated economic priority. Default the state filter to human-dependent, allow every configured state, show the owning phase, and open the aim editor from a ranked result.

status.comment: Implemented and internally verified; awaiting user acceptance of the phase-header interaction and ranked subtree presentation.

reflection: Implemented in packages/frontend/src/components/Phase.vue with pure recursive ranking helpers in packages/frontend/src/utils/phase-priority.ts and focused tests. The control defaults to human-dependent, supports every configured state, recursively loads descendant phases, excludes archived aims, ranks by calculated priority, labels the owning phase, and opens the editor on selection. Verification: focused Vitest 3/3, frontend vue-tsc, production Vite build, and git diff --check all passed. Development server was not touched.
